set: A: the two judged stills of the Decision page and two grids of native-size crops of their surfaces

issues.where: glass edge crop, upper left, and contact-shadow crop, lower middle
issues.what: The slab has a bevel and a tight contact line, but its face reads as opaque grey plastic. The paper grain stops at the edge instead of continuing through the glass, and there is little optical shift or reflection at the corner.
issues.fix: Let a muted version of the underlying paper grain show through, shift it slightly at the bevel, and add a narrow grazing reflection at the corner.

issues.where: glass card and readout crops, middle row
issues.what: The three readouts resemble recesses molded into the same grey plastic as the card. The card face, inner faces and lettering do not read as separate layers under glass.
issues.fix: Separate the glass cover from the backing and readout faces, show a narrow depth gap at the cutouts, and carry a faint cover reflection across one readout.

issues.where: orange 5 in the progress-row crop, lower middle
issues.what: The cap has convincing curvature, but the orange lower ring and cap read as one piece sitting above the rail. No stationary socket or clearance is visible around the moving cap.
issues.fix: Set a thin stationary collar into the rail, with a narrow dark clearance around the cap and a tighter shadow where the collar meets the rail.

issues.where: arrow face and upper-left edge, lower-left crop
issues.what: The heel shows some thickness, but most of the arrow is a nearly uniform white face bounded by a dark outline. The long edges do not catch enough light to read as beveled sides.
issues.fix: Make the bevel visible along the long edges with a narrow directional glint and a graded face reflection, leaving the shaded sidewall darkest at the heel.
